decision.reason: [ev-8b7267b73a1c] says Structured Metadata is enabled by default in Loki 3.0 and requires the active schema to use both the tsdb index type and the v13 schema. The excerpt stops at "you have two options:", so it never says what happens to an environment that does neither. The proposed statement that the feature "will not function properly" is a guess, and so is the behavior-change kind. If the real outcome is a failure (for example, Loki refusing to start or the upgrade being blocked), behavior-change would hide it. To decide, I need the rest of this upgrade-guide section (the two options and what happens if neither is taken).
